# RD Arena, original build (2026-08-08)

**Frozen. Do not edit.** Restored 2026-11-15 from git (`0a192d5`, uploaded 2026-08-08; identical
copy at `8d510d2:rd-arena/RDArena.html`) so Ry can play it again. This is the first RD Arena: one
self-contained file, a full Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion field (feed 0.055) the arena grows on,
shockwave physics, WASD / mouse aim / hold-and-release E to dash. It was replaced on 2026-09-07 by
the v2 rewrite (`rd-arena.pre-mp/`), which simplified the field, and then by multiplayer
(`rd-arena/`, 2026-09-08).

Double-click `RDArena.html` to play. Headless check 2026-11-15: loads, no console errors.
